snippet.title: Can We Cook? – Official Announcement Trailer | Kiki Games
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5586390/Can_We_Cook/

Three friends. One restaurant. What could go wrong? 🍳

In Can We Cook?, one of you can’t see, one can’t hear, and one can’t speak! Team up in this chaotic 3 player online co op cooking game, where getting the recipe across might be harder than cooking it.

📝 The Waiter knows the orders and recipes but must communicate through writing and drawings.
📣 The Chef manages ingredients and guides the Cook but can’t hear the team.
🍳 The Cook prepares the meals without seeing a thing.

Take orders, figure out the recipes, and try to serve dinner before everything burns!

🎮 Wishlist Can We Cook? on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5586390/Can_We_Cook/

Grab two friends, choose your roles, and get ready for shouting, misunderstandings, and burnt food!

#CanWeCook #coopgames #cookinggame
